scoring_justification: DFT relative energies are deterministic within the specified functional/basis; the agent reports the computed energies; the checker compares them and derived barriers to paper-reported hidden values with tolerances. Since no lower-level raw outputs exist that would allow recomputation of energies, result-level comparison is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold DFT relative energies and activation barriers from Table 1 of the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 of the paper (energies from DFT column: A=+0.69, B=-0.04, C=-0.76, D=-0.39, E=-0.60). Barriers derived: insertion=E(A)=0.69, H-transfer=E(D)-E(C)=0.37
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly as reported in the reference paper, traceable to Table 1

outputs.description: Computed relative DFT energies of the five stationary points A-E along the dissociative insertion pathway. The reference state (RS) energy is taken as zero by convention and is not listed.

output_contract.notes: The checker will validate the CSV format, derive activation barriers (insertion barrier = E(A) - E(RS), H-transfer barrier = E(D) - E(C)), compare the five relative energies and two barriers to the hidden reference values within absolute tolerances, and verify structural ordering constraints. No MD simulation is required.
